name: Little Sister -Oshikake Dousei Seikatsu-
original_name: Little Sister －おしかけ同棲生活－
source:
Simulate living together with your sister!
It's all up to you to choose whether to spoil her, take care of her, and what kind of sex you want to have with her!
With tap actions, you can stroke her head, talk to her, touch her, and enjoy her reactions.
At the end of the day, of course, there are things that lovers do together...
translation:
模拟和姐姐一起生活！
是否宠她、照顾她、想和她发生什么样的性关系，全由你来选择！
通过点击动作，你可以抚摸她的头，与她交谈，触摸她，并享受她的反应。
当然，在一天结束时，有些事情是恋人一起做的……
